sections.title: 1. Who We Are
sections.content: Hisaab ("we", "us", "our") is a personal finance tracking application built and operated as an independent project. Hisaab is not a financial institution, bank, or regulated financial service.

sections.title: 2. What Data We Collect
sections.content:
Account Data:
• Display name, currency preference, opening balance, and creation date (Not encrypted).
• Email address (Not encrypted — required for login and emails).
• Password (bcrypt hash only — never stored as plaintext).

Financial Records:
• Transactions: Title & Note (AES-256-GCM encrypted). Amount, Type, Date, Category (Not encrypted).
• Categories: Name, Emoji, Type, Limit (Not encrypted).
• Dues: Title, Person's name, Note (AES-256-GCM encrypted). Amount, Date, Status (Not encrypted).
• Splits: Title, Note, Participant names (AES-256-GCM encrypted). Amounts, Date (Not encrypted).
• Savings: Total amount, Cash deduction (Not encrypted).
• Wishlist: Title (AES-256-GCM encrypted). Emoji, URL, Price, Amount saved (Not encrypted).
• Recurring: Title (AES-256-GCM encrypted). Amount, Type, Frequency, Next due date (Not encrypted).

UPI Screenshot Data (on-device only, never uploaded):
• When you share a UPI payment screenshot to Hisaab, the image is processed entirely on your device using Google ML Kit. Hisaab extracts: transaction amount, date, time, and payment direction (sent/received). The image file is not copied, stored, or transmitted by Hisaab.

Tokens & Technical Data:
• Auth tokens are stored in device secure storage.
• Server logs (IP, path, timestamp) retained for 30 days. IP is tracked in-memory for rate limiting.

sections.title: 3. What Is & Is Not Encrypted
sections.content:
Encrypted with AES-256-GCM:
• Transaction titles and notes
• Due titles, person names, and notes
• Split titles, notes, and participant names
• Wishlist item titles
• Recurring transaction titles

Not Encrypted (stored as plaintext):
• Your name and email address
• All numeric amounts
• Category names and emojis
• Dates and timestamps
• Boolean flags (paid/unpaid, income/expense)
• Wishlist URLs

⚠️ Operator Access: Hisaab uses server-side encryption. The encryption key lives on the server. While we do not read your data, the operator is technically capable of decrypting it.

sections.title: 4. How We Use Your Data
sections.content:
We use your data for:
• Providing the app (storing and displaying records)
• Account authentication
• Sending transactional emails (verification, resets)
• Security monitoring and rate limiting
• Responding to support requests

We do not use your data for advertising, profiling, or sale to third parties. We have no advertising partners.

sections.title: 5. Where Your Data Is Stored
sections.content:
• Database (Neon/AWS): ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
• API Server (Render): Oregon, USA
• Email Delivery (Brevo): European Union (France)

Your data is transmitted over HTTPS at all times. Transfers to third countries are covered by Data Processing Agreements and Standard Contractual Clauses.

sections.title: 6. Data Retention
sections.content:
• Your account and financial records are retained until you delete your account.
• Deleted account data is permanently erased after the 5-day grace period expires.
• Server access logs are purged after 30 days.
• Password reset / email change tokens expire in 1 hour.

sections.title: 7. Account Deletion & Erasure
sections.content: You can delete your account from More → Delete Account. This initiates a 5-day grace period. If you do not log in within 5 days, all your data is permanently and irreversibly deleted. There are no backups of your data after deletion.

sections.title: 8. Cookies & Local Storage
sections.content: Hisaab is a mobile app and does not use browser cookies. We use device secure storage (iOS Keychain / Android Keystore) to store your JWT access/refresh tokens. These are cleared when you log out.

sections.title: 9. Your Rights Under GDPR
sections.content:
If you are in the EEA or UK, you have the right to:
• Access your data (view in-app)
• Rectify your data (update in Profile)
• Erasure (delete account)
• Data portability (email us for a JSON export)
• Object to or restrict processing
• Withdraw consent

sections.title: 10. Your Rights Under CCPA
sections.content: California residents have the right to know, delete, and correct their personal information, and the right to non-discrimination. We do not sell or share your personal information. Contact us to exercise these rights.

sections.title: 11. UPI Transaction Screenshot Sharing
sections.content:
Hisaab includes an optional feature that lets you share a UPI payment screenshot (from apps like GPay, PhonePe, or Paytm) directly to Hisaab.

How it works:
• You initiate the share from within the UPI app — Hisaab never accesses your gallery or camera on its own.
• The image is processed entirely on your device using Google ML Kit Text Recognition (on-device OCR). No image data leaves your device.
• Hisaab extracts: amount, date, time, and payment direction (expense or income). Merchant/payee name is never auto-populated.
• The extracted fields are pre-filled in the Add Transaction form. You review and confirm before anything is saved.
• Hisaab does not store or transmit the screenshot itself.

Third-Party SDK: Google ML Kit Text Recognition (on-device model) is used for OCR. The model runs locally; no data is sent to Google's servers as part of this process. Google's ML Kit is subject to Google's own Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 12. Children's Privacy
sections.content: Hisaab is not directed at children under the age of 13 (or 16 in the EEA). We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. If you believe a minor has created an account, please contact us for prompt deletion.

sections.title: 13. Security
sections.content: We protect your data using AES-256-GCM encryption, bcrypt hashing, JWT tokens, HTTPS, and rate limiting. UPI screenshot OCR is performed entirely on-device using Google ML Kit — no image data is transmitted to our servers or to third parties. However, no system is perfectly secure and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 14. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. For significant changes, we will notify users via email or an in-app notice.

sections.title: 15. Contact Us
sections.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us at projecthisaab.app@gmail.com with the subject "Privacy Inquiry". We will respond within 14 business days.

sections.content:
Hisaab is a personal finance tracking application. It allows you to record transactions, manage categories, track dues, split expenses, set savings goals, and log UPI transactions by sharing payment screenshots from third-party UPI apps.

Hisaab is not a bank, payment processor, or financial institution. Nothing in the App constitutes financial, investment, tax, or legal advice.

sections.title: 7. UPI Screenshot Sharing Feature
sections.content:
Hisaab provides an optional feature that allows you to share UPI payment screenshots from third-party apps (e.g. GPay, PhonePe, Paytm) to Hisaab for automatic pre-filling of the Add Transaction form.

By using this feature, you acknowledge that:
• OCR processing is performed on-device using Google ML Kit. No image data is sent to Hisaab's servers.
• Pre-filled transaction details are suggestions based on OCR output and may contain errors. You are responsible for reviewing and correcting data before saving.
• Hisaab is not responsible for inaccuracies caused by OCR misreads, image quality, or unsupported UPI app formats.
• This feature requires Android's Intent sharing mechanism. No permission to access your camera or gallery is requested by Hisaab — you initiate the share yourself from within the UPI app.
• Google ML Kit's use is subject to Google's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
